arxiv-2103-13382.title: DERIVED CATEGORIES OF hyper-Kähler MANIFOLDS: Extended Mukai vector and integral structure
arxiv-2103-13382.creator: Thorsten Beckmann
arxiv-2103-13382.description: Abstract . We introduce a linearised form of the square root of the Todd class inside the Verbitsky component of a hyper-Kähler manifold using the extended Mukai lattice. This enables us to define a Mukai vector for certain objects in the derived category taking values inside the extended Mukai lattice which is functorial for derived equivalences.

arxiv-2110-01907.title: Spin-1 resonances
arxiv-2110-01907.creator: Stefania De Curtis, Daniele Dominici
arxiv-2110-01907.description: Abstract Spin-1 resonances are naturally present in composite Higgs frameworks. We first review a model independent approach to parameterize a single additional heavy triplet and then we consider more realistic models arising in composite Higgs scenarios where a larger number of spin-1 resonances is expected.

arxiv-2203-15390.title: ReIL: A Framework for Reinforced Intervention-based Imitation Learning
arxiv-2203-15390.creator: Rom Parnichkun, Matthew N. Dailey, Atsushi Yamashita
arxiv-2203-15390.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rom Parnichkun, Matthew N. Dailey, Atsushi Yamashita. Compared to traditional imitation learning methods such as DAgger and DART, intervention-based imitation offers a more convenient and sample efficient data collection process to users. In this paper, we introduce Reinforced Intervention-based Learning (ReIL), a framework consisting of a general intervention-based learning algorithm and a multi-task imitation learning model aimed at enabling non-expert users to train agents in real environments with little supervision or fine tuning.

arxiv-2212-02015.title: Learning Imbalanced Data with Vision Transformers
arxiv-2212-02015.creator: Zhengzhuo Xu Ruikang Liu Shuo Yang Zenghao Chai Chun YuanShenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University, China {xzzthu, liuruikang.cs, ysss9264, zenghaochai}@gmail.com yuanc@sz.tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2212-02015.description: Abstract The real-world data tends to be heavily imbalanced and severely skew the data-driven deep neural networks, which makes Long-Tailed Recognition (LTR) a massive challenging task. Existing LTR methods seldom train Vision Transformers (ViTs) with Long-Tailed (LT) data, while the off-the-shelf pretrain weight of ViTs always leads to unfair comparisons.

arxiv-2309-14826.title: From CT scans to 4-manifold topology via neutral geometry
arxiv-2309-14826.creator: Brendan Guilfoyle
arxiv-2309-14826.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Brendan Guilfoyle. In this survey paper the ultrahyperbolic equation in dimension four is discussed from a geometric, analytic and topological point of view. The geometry centres on the canonical neutral metric on the space of oriented geodesics of 3-dimensional space-forms, the analysis discusses a mean value theorem for solutions of the equation and presents a new solution of the Cauchy problem over a certain family of null hypersurfaces, while the topology relates to generalizations of codimension two foliations of 4-manifolds.

arxiv-2404-01387.title: Inferring flavor mixtures in multijet events
arxiv-2404-01387.creator: Ezequiel Alvarez, Yuling Yao
arxiv-2404-01387.description: Abstract Multijet events with heavy-flavors are of central importance at the LHC since many relevant processes—such as t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} , h ​ h hh , t ​ t ¯ ​ h t\bar{t}h and others—have a preferred branching ratio for this final state.

arxiv-2404-17393.title: Equivariant Lagrangian Floer homology via multiplicative flow trees Thanks: This work was funded by EPSRC grant reference EP/T012749/1, the Simons Collaboration grant no. 994320, and the ERC-SyG project ReNewQuantum
arxiv-2404-17393.creator: Guillem Cazassus
arxiv-2404-17393.description: Abstract . We provide constructions of equivariant Lagrangian Floer homology groups, by constructing and exploiting an A ∞ A_{\infty} -module structure on the Floer complex. 1. Introduction 1.1. Background Equivariant homology of a G -space X is a rich invariant that is usually better behaved than the homology of the quotient, when the action is not free.

arxiv-2407-01753.title: Rényi second laws for black holes
arxiv-2407-01753.creator: Alice Bernamonti, Federico Galli, Robert C. Myers, and Ignacio A. Reyes
arxiv-2407-01753.description: Abstract Hawking’s black hole area theorem provides a geometric realization of the second law of thermodynamics and constrains gravitational processes. In this work we explore a one-parameter extension of this constraint formulated in terms of the monotonicity properties of Rényi entropies.

arxiv-2408-03028.title: Investigating the Jamming Attack on 5 5 G NR Physical Channels
arxiv-2408-03028.creator: Mohsen Kazemian
arxiv-2408-03028.description: Abstract This study investigates the jamming attack on the orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) based physical channels in 5 5 G new radio (NR) technology from the aspect of signal processing. Disrupting the orthogonality property between subcarriers (SCs) is considered as one of the jammers’ targets in OFDM based generations.

arxiv-2502-05591.title: Round and Resilience-Optimal Approximate Agreement on Trees and Block Graphs
arxiv-2502-05591.creator: Marc Fuchs, Diana Ghinea, Zahra Parsaeian, Joel Rybicki
arxiv-2502-05591.description: Abstract Approximate Agreement ( 𝒜 ​ 𝒜 \mathcal{AA} ) is a fundamental primitive that, even in the presence of Byzantine faults, allows honest parties to obtain close (but not necessarily identical) outputs that lie within the range of their inputs.

arxiv-2504-09320.title: Capillary Christoffel-Minkowski problem
arxiv-2504-09320.creator: Yingxiang Hu, Mohammad N. Ivaki, Julian Scheuer
arxiv-2504-09320.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yingxiang Hu, Mohammad N. Ivaki, Julian Scheuer. The result of Guan and Ma (Invent. 151 (2003)) states that if ϕ − 1 / k : 𝕊 n → ( 0 , ∞ ) \phi^{-1/k}:\mathbb{S}^{n}\to(0,\infty) is spherically convex, then ϕ \phi arises as the σ k \sigma_{k} curvature (the k k -th elementary symmetric function of the principal radii of curvature) of a strictly convex hypersurface.

pmc-12650873.title: From Industry to Dentistry: A Comprehensive Review of Zeolite as a Next-Generation Multifunctional Filler for Enhanced Mechanical Reinforcement and Antimicrobial Efficacy
pmc-12650873.creator: Sohaib Fadhil Mohammed, Mohd Firdaus Yhaya, Abdul Fattah Nongman, Matheel Al-Rawas, Marwan N. Arbilei, Tahir Yusuf Noorani
pmc-12650873.description: Zeolites are becoming potentially important multifunctional fillers in dentistry, providing a distinctive blend of mechanical reinforcement, remineralization, and antimicrobial properties. Their crystalline aluminosilicate frameworks offer ion-exchange capacity, the controlled release of therapeutic ions (Ag+, Zn2+, Ca2+, Sr2+, Cu2+), and compatibility with various dental composites. Sustainable and cost-effective zeolite production has become possible due to recent developments in synthetic strategies.

pmc-12706767.title: Myelinated fiber labeling and orientation mapping of the human brain with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy
pmc-12706767.creator: Michele Sorelli, Danila Di Meo, Samuel Bradley, Franco Cheli, Josephine Ramazzotti, Federica F Caria, Laura Perego, Christophe Destrieux, Patrick R Hof, Francesco S Pavone, Giacomo Mazzamuto, Irene Costantini
pmc-12706767.description: The convoluted network of myelinated fibers that supports behavior, cognition, and sensory processing in the human brain is the source of its extraordinary complexity. Advancements in tissue optical clearing, 3D fluorescence microscopy, and automated image analysis have enabled unprecedented insights into the architecture of these networks.

pmc-12888038.title: The NERD model: reflex circuit dysfunction as a systems-level driver of persistent post-concussion symptoms
pmc-12888038.creator: Matthew M. Antonucci, Kenneth Jay
pmc-12888038.description: Persistent post-concussive symptoms are often attributed to diffuse cortical dysfunction, yet this perspective may overlook key systems-level mechanisms. We propose a conceptual framework in which dysfunction arises from the dynamic interplay among five functional nodes: the sensory interface, reflex-brain stem hub, cerebellar module, basal ganglia–thalamic modulator, and cerebral cortex.

pmc-13519139.title: Enhancing Self Care Among Oral Cancer Survivors Using a Digital Approach: The Empowered Survivor Trial
pmc-13519139.creator: Sharon L Manne, Shawna V Hudson, Janet H Van Cleave, Marissa Grosso, Sara Frederick, Morgan Pesanelli, Neetu Singh, Justin Solleder, Denalee M O'Malley, Elizabeth Handorf, Shou‐En Lu
pmc-13519139.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundOral and oropharyngeal cancer survivors experience debilitating physical and psychosocial challenges. Little knowledge exists on the efficacy of interventions to enhance self‐efficacy in managing these challenges, increase survivorship preparedness, and improve health‐related quality of life (HRQoL).MethodsIndividuals (n = 643) diagnosed with oral or oropharyngeal cancer diagnosed within past 3 years were randomized to a digital intervention, Empowered Survivor (ES) or a Generic Online Intervention (GO).

pmc-13551117.creator: Luciano Ibba, Luigi Gargiulo, Matteo Bianco, Sara Di Giulio, Ruggero Cascio Ingurgio, Angela Alfano, Carlo A Vignoli, Mario Valenti, Paola Facheris, Chiara Perugini, Alessandra Narcisi, Antonio Costanzo
pmc-13551117.description: However, their use is associated with adverse events (AEs), which may affect the continuation of therapy and the overall quality of life of patients. 2 A case of amenorrhea was recently reported in a patient treated with upadacitinib for AD. 3 The mechanism underlying this AE is not fully understood.

pmc-13627805.title: Effect of infusing ghee with Ayurvedic herb mix (Murchana) on its oxidative stability and its comparative analysis with medicated ghee (Siddha Ghrita)
pmc-13627805.creator: Deepshikha Kataria, Madhuri N Hegde, Gurmeet Singh
pmc-13627805.description: BackgroundThe preparation of medicated ghee, known as siddha ghrita in Ayurveda, faces significant challenges due to lipid susceptibility to oxidation, which reduces shelf life and potentially leads to the loss of bioactive compounds. A popular lipid-stabilization process, murchana, has been recommended in Ayurveda as a pre-treatment for ghee with an Ayurvedic herb mix, which may improve its stability.
